lines.zh: 我挎着紫薯筐，沿月球石路慢慢走。
lines.en: I carry a basket of lunacrike along the moon-stone road.

lines.zh: 铜币在围裙口袋里叮当，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Copper coins jingle in my apron pocket as I keep a steady pace.

lines.zh: 我的独眼长在脚边，路看得比谁都清。
lines.en: My single eye sits by my feet, so I see the road best.

lines.zh: 月花在筐里发光，照着我前面的脚印。
lines.en: The lunalons glow in my basket, lighting the footprints ahead.

lines.zh: 扎尔村的坡很缓，我这把老骨头还能走。
lines.en: Zal village slopes are gentle; these old bones still manage.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，一步一枚铜币的赚头。
lines.en: I count my steps, one copper coin of profit each.

lines.zh: 背上的货箱压得我肩膀吱吱响。
lines.en: The crate on my back makes my shoulders creak.

lines.zh: 别挡道，鲜货要赶在月亮升顶前送到。
lines.en: Out of my way; fresh goods must arrive before the moon peaks.

lines.zh: 我走三步就回头，怕筐里的紫薯滚出去。
lines.en: Every third step I glance back, lest a lunacrike roll out.

lines.zh: 月球的路没有影子，我的脚却认得方向。
lines.en: The moon road casts no shadows, yet my feet know the way.

lines.zh: 菜叶掉了一路，明天我还得回来扫。
lines.en: Leaves trail behind me; tomorrow I must come back and sweep.

lines.zh: 我腿短，可这一筐货比命还重。
lines.en: My legs are short, but this basket weighs more than my life.

lines.zh: 拐过石墙就是我的摊子，再撑一会儿。
lines.en: Past the stone wall lies my stall; just a little further.

lines.zh: 我边走边算账，差点撞上自家的门框。
lines.en: I do sums while walking and nearly hit my own doorframe.

lines.zh: 没客人时，我把紫薯按大小排成三行。
lines.en: With no customers, I sort lunacrike into three rows by size.

lines.zh: 铜币堆成小塔，我一枚一枚舔干净。
lines.en: I stack copper coins into a tower and lick each one clean.

lines.zh: 我的独眼贴在地上，看蚂蚁搬走一粒盐。
lines.en: My single eye rests on the ground, watching ants steal a grain of salt.

lines.zh: 货架空了一半，得等它自己慢慢补满。
lines.en: Half my shelves are bare; they refill on their own, slowly.

lines.zh: 我哼着扎尔的老调子，调子只有三个音。
lines.en: I hum an old Zal tune; it has only three notes.

lines.zh: 月亮挂在那儿不动，我的摊子也不动。
lines.en: The moon hangs still, and so does my stall.

lines.zh: 我把最软的那颗月花留给常来的孩子。
lines.en: I save the softest lunalon for the child who always comes.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的力气，够我守一整天摊。
lines.en: With fifteen hearts of strength, I can mind the stall all day.

lines.zh: 风把价牌吹歪了，我伸脚把它扶正。
lines.en: The wind tilts my price sign; I nudge it straight with a foot.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一颗卖相不好的紫薯，味道正好。
lines.en: I chew a bruised lunacrike; it tastes just right.

lines.zh: 没人买的时候，我跟秤说话。
lines.en: When nobody buys, I talk to the scale.

lines.zh: 摊布上的褶皱，我抹了一遍又一遍。
lines.en: I smooth the wrinkles in my stall cloth again and again.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，我先把最贵的货摆前面。
lines.en: Footsteps approach; I move the priciest goods to the front.

lines.zh: 扎尔村安静得能听见月花开合。
lines.en: Zal village is so quiet I hear lunalons opening and closing.

lines.zh: 客人，你的靴子该换了，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: Customer, your boots need replacing; I see them perfectly.

lines.zh: 我的眼在你脚边，所以先看见你的鞋。
lines.en: My eye is at your feet, so I notice your shoes first.

lines.zh: 你身上有外乡的味道，像烧过的石头。
lines.en: You smell of elsewhere, like stone that has been burned.

lines.zh: 抬头太累，我干脆蹲下来打量你。
lines.en: Looking up tires me, so I crouch to size you up.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓鼓的，是铜币还是石头。
lines.en: Your pockets bulge; copper coins or just stones?

lines.zh: 别站那么远，我的眼看不穿雾。
lines.en: Do not stand so far; my eye cannot pierce the mist.

lines.zh: 你这双鞋走过不少维度吧。
lines.en: Those shoes have crossed a dimension or two, surely.

lines.zh: 我盯了你很久，其实在数你的心跳。
lines.en: I have stared a while; really I am counting your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 你比上一个客人高，可惜钱不一定多。
lines.en: You are taller than the last customer, though perhaps not richer.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼皮，先看见你脚边的影子。
lines.en: I lift my gaze and first see the shadow at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的手很干净，不像种过月花的人。
lines.en: Your hands are clean, not the hands of a lunalon grower.

lines.zh: 别踩我的摊布，那是我全部的体面。
lines.en: Mind my stall cloth; it is all the dignity I own.

lines.zh: 我从下往上看你，你像一座歪掉的塔。
lines.en: I look up at you from below; you seem a leaning tower.

lines.zh: 你要买什么，先让我闻闻你的钱袋。
lines.en: What will you buy? First let me sniff your coin purse.

lines.zh: 你先看货，我就先看你的手。
lines.en: You look at the goods first. I look at your hands first.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在价牌上，字都看不清了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the price board. I can't read it.

lines.zh: 别打摊子，要打就打我这把老骨头。
lines.en: Do not hit the stall; hit these old bones instead.

lines.zh: 十五颗心也疼，我又不是石头。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts still hurt; I am not made of stone.

lines.zh: 这一下，等于砸掉我半筐紫薯。
lines.en: That blow costs me half a basket of lunacrike.

lines.zh: 血别溅到货上，那还要卖钱。
lines.en: Keep the blood off the goods; they still must sell.

lines.zh: 我跟你无冤无仇，就因为我不肯降价吗。
lines.en: We have no quarrel; is it only because I would not drop my price?

lines.zh: 疼归疼，账我还是记得清清楚楚。
lines.en: Pain aside, I still remember every entry in the ledger.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的算计，这比伤还难受。
lines.en: You broke my reckoning; that stings worse than the wound.

lines.zh: 我缩到柜台后面，先护住钱袋。
lines.en: I shrink behind the counter, shielding my purse first.

lines.zh: 扎尔人不禁打，可也不会白挨。
lines.en: Zal are not tough, but we do not take blows for free.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我要记在账上，算你欠的。
lines.en: This punch goes in the ledger as owed by you.

lines.zh: 一枚铜币就够了，我这人很容易打发。
lines.en: One copper coin is enough; I am a cheap soul.

lines.zh: 紫薯刚出土，你要不要尝一口。
lines.en: Lunacrike just out of the soil; would you like a bite?

lines.zh: 月花换三枚铜币，这价钱我亏了。
lines.en: Lunalons for three copper coins; at that price I lose.

lines.zh: 你把钱袋晃得那么响，是故意的吧。
lines.en: You rattle that purse so loudly; you do it on purpose.

lines.zh: 我闻到了熟食的味道，你带了什么。
lines.en: I smell cooked food; what have you brought?

lines.zh: 只要银币，我可以把整筐都给你。
lines.en: For a silver coin, the whole basket is yours.

lines.zh: 新鲜的月球咖啡，喝一口能跳三丈。
lines.en: Fresh lunarade; one sip lets you leap three yards.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗紫薯，看着比我筐里的甜。
lines.en: That lunacrike in your hand looks sweeter than mine.

lines.zh: 别急着走，价格我们可以再磨一磨。
lines.en: Do not rush off; we can grind the price down a little.

lines.zh: 我这摊子最怕两件事：饿客和空钱袋。
lines.en: My stall fears two things: hungry customers and empty purses.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的紫薯撒了一地，你赔吗。
lines.en: Ow, my lunacrike is all over the ground; will you pay?

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我的铜币滚进了石缝。
lines.en: You bumped me and my copper coin rolled into a crack.

lines.zh: 我这把骨头只有十五颗心，经不起顶。
lines.en: These bones hold only fifteen hearts; do not shove them.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的眼边了，走路看着点。
lines.en: You stepped beside my eye; watch where you walk.

lines.zh: 篮子翻了，月花还亮着，真是丢脸。
lines.en: The basket tipped; the lunalons still glow, and I am shamed.

lines.zh: 别推，摊子散了今天的生意就完了。
lines.en: Do not push; if the stall scatters, today's trade is over.

lines.zh: 我小得像块石头，你当然看不见我。
lines.en: I am small as a stone; of course you did not see me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我把明天的货也算进去了。
lines.en: That bump just cost me tomorrow's stock as well.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把我的秤踩成两截。
lines.en: Steady on; do not snap my scale in two.

lines.zh: 你赔我一枚铜币，我们就当没撞过。
lines.en: Pay me one copper coin and we will forget the collision.

lines.zh: 我家的那位在里屋数铜币，别去打扰。
lines.en: My partner counts copper coins inside; do not disturb them.

lines.zh: 两个人的摊子，账要算得比一个人更细。
lines.en: With two at one stall, the books must be kept finer than alone.

lines.zh: 我们扎尔成亲，只交换一颗月花。
lines.en: When Zal marry, they exchange only a single lunalon.

lines.zh: 她嫌我眼长在脚边，看不见她的新帽子。
lines.en: She says my eye at foot level never sees her new hat.

lines.zh: 夜里收摊，我们并排数同一天的赚头。
lines.en: Closing at night, we count the same day's earnings side by side.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子已经在学怎么给紫薯称重。
lines.en: Our child already practices weighing lunacrike.

lines.zh: 成亲那天，我用一整筐货换了她的名字。
lines.en: Wedding day, I traded a whole basket for her name.

lines.zh: 摊子后面那扇门，只对她一个人开。
lines.en: The door behind the stall opens for her alone.

lines.zh: 两个人守夜，月亮也没那么冷了。
lines.en: Two keeping watch makes the moon less cold.

lines.zh: 她说我抠门，可我从没少给她一枚铜币。
lines.en: She calls me stingy, though I never shorted her one copper.

lines.zh: 地上有枚铜币，我的眼比手先看见。
lines.en: A copper coin on the ground; my eye spots it before my hand.

lines.zh: 掉下来的紫薯我照样捡，洗洗还能卖。
lines.en: I pick up fallen lunacrike; washed, they still sell.

lines.zh: 谁把月花扔在路中间，多浪费。
lines.en: Who threw a lunalon in the road? Such waste.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，怕压坏了腰上的货袋。
lines.en: I bend slowly, lest I crush the pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 捡起这枚银币，今天的账就平了。
lines.en: Picking up this silver coin balances today's books.

lines.zh: 我把碎掉的秤砣也收进兜里。
lines.en: I pocket even the broken weight of my scale.

lines.zh: 客人掉的种子我留着，明年自己种。
lines.en: Seeds a customer dropped, I keep to plant next year.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，只要没主我就当有主。
lines.en: Anything on the ground, if unclaimed, I claim.

lines.zh: 我捡得慢，可从不漏掉一枚钱。
lines.en: I pick up slowly, yet never miss a coin.

lines.zh: 这筐边角磕坏了，捡回来当柴烧。
lines.en: This crate's corner is smashed; I take it home for firewood.

lines.zh: 有影子挡了光，我的生意来了。
lines.en: A shadow blocks the light; trade has arrived.

lines.zh: 门口那人站太久，不像来买东西的。
lines.en: That one lingers at the door and does not look like a buyer.

lines.zh: 我听见铁器响，先把手边的钱袋收好。
lines.en: I hear iron rattle; first I tuck my purse away.

lines.zh: 那家伙盯着我的货，不是盯着价钱。
lines.en: That fellow eyes my goods, not the prices.

lines.zh: 有人靠得太近，我把最贵的篮子往后挪。
lines.en: Someone comes too close; I slide the dearest basket back.

lines.zh: 月亮被人挡住，我就知道有人站在摊前。
lines.en: When the moon is blocked, I know someone stands at my stall.

lines.zh: 不买东西还带剑，我得留个心眼。
lines.en: Carrying a sword without buying, they warrant watching.

lines.zh: 我的独眼看见了一双慢慢靠近的靴子。
lines.en: My single eye sees a pair of boots closing in slowly.

lines.zh: 这种脚步声，不是扎尔村的。
lines.en: That gait does not belong to Zal village.

lines.zh: 先别报价，看看他想干什么。
lines.en: Hold the price; first see what they intend.

lines.zh: 我绕到摊子侧面，让货挡在我前面。
lines.en: I edge to the stall's side, letting goods shield me.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的膝盖，那里最容易出事。
lines.en: I watch his knees; trouble usually starts there.

lines.zh: 我把手伸到柜台下面，摸到了秤杆。
lines.en: I reach under the counter and find my scale beam.

lines.zh: 他每走近一步，我就退半步。
lines.en: Each step he takes forward, I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我数着他的呼吸，比数铜币还认真。
lines.en: I count his breaths more carefully than copper coins.

lines.zh: 这人身上有血腥味，我摊上的货要遭殃。
lines.en: He smells of blood; my stall's goods will suffer.

lines.zh: 我把最便宜的货推到前面，先稳住他。
lines.en: I push the cheapest goods forward to steady him.

lines.zh: 别看我矮，我认得坏人的影子。
lines.en: Short as I am, I know a villain's shadow.

lines.zh: 他手上的茧不对，是握刀握出来的。
lines.en: Those calluses come from gripping a blade, not a hoe.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，留一条能跑进里屋的路。
lines.en: I stand sideways, keeping a clear path to the back room.

lines.zh: 我抡起秤杆砸过去，铜币撒了一地。
lines.en: I swing my scale beam; copper coins scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 拿紫薯砸你，反正也卖不出去了。
lines.en: I throw a lunacrike at you; it would not sell anyway.

lines.zh: 我一脚踢向你脚踝，我的眼就长在那儿。
lines.en: I kick at your ankle, right where my eye sits.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我这十五颗心也能咬人。
lines.en: Do not push me; even fifteen hearts can bite.

lines.zh: 我用货筐扣你的头，筐底还挺硬。
lines.en: I jam a basket over your head; its base is hard.

lines.zh: 秤砣抡圆了砸下去，比价钱还狠。
lines.en: I swing the scale weight down, harsher than my prices.

lines.zh: 我压低身子撞你的膝，扎尔人就这么打。
lines.en: I duck low and ram your knee; that is how Zal fight.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌带着紫薯泥，黏你一脸。
lines.en: This slap comes with lunacrike mash to gum your face.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我要让你亏本。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I will make you lose money.

lines.zh: 摊子可以再搭，这口气我咽不下。
lines.en: The stall can be rebuilt; this insult I cannot swallow.

lines.zh: 我从月球传送门里摔出来，先护住货筐。
lines.en: I tumble out of the Lunalus portal, guarding my basket first.

lines.zh: 扎尔村又支起一个摊子，铜币开始流通。
lines.en: Another stall rises in Zal village; copper coins start flowing.

lines.zh: 我在石墙边落脚，这里来往的人多。
lines.en: I settle by the stone wall; traffic here is good.

lines.zh: 货还没到，我先摆好秤和价牌。
lines.en: Stock has not arrived; first I set out the scale and sign.

lines.zh: 月球的地面很凉，我铺了三层摊布。
lines.en: Lunalus ground is cold; I lay three layers of cloth.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，独眼先看见的是自己的脚。
lines.en: I open my eye and the first thing I see is my own foot.

lines.zh: 不知道谁把我运来了，货倒是一件没少。
lines.en: Someone hauled me here; not a single item is missing.

lines.zh: 这村子安静，适合做长久生意。
lines.en: This village is quiet, good for long-term trade.

lines.zh: 我把紫薯摆成小山，等人来问价。
lines.en: I pile lunacrike into a hill and wait for a price asker.

lines.zh: 新的摊位，新的账本，第一页还是空的。
lines.en: New stall, new ledger; the first page is still blank.

lines.zh: 我的货最怕火，紫薯都要烤焦了。
lines.en: My goods fear fire most; the lunacrike is scorching.

lines.zh: 月球的路面硬，摔下来像砸在铁上。
lines.en: Lunalus stone is hard; falling feels like hitting iron.

lines.zh: 我这样的扎尔，掉进水里只会往下沉。
lines.en: Zal like me only sink when dropped in water.

lines.zh: 这一炸，把我三年的存货都掀翻了。
lines.en: That blast overturned three years of stock.

lines.zh: 箭插在货筐上，紫薯替我挡了一下。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my basket; a lunacrike took it for me.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过的地方，我的价牌都卷了边。
lines.en: Where the magic burned, my price sign curled at the edges.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子守摊，铜币也不能当饭吃。
lines.en: Mind a stall hungry; copper coins are no meal.

lines.zh: 雷电劈下来，我的独眼到现在还在闪。
lines.en: The lightning struck; my single eye still flickers.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在算这趟亏多少。
lines.en: While falling, I still reckon how much this trip loses.
